recipes.title: Carrot Cake Baked Oats with Cottage Cheese Frosting
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C / 350°F. Mash the banana in a bowl, then whisk in the eggs, milk, Greek yogurt, zero-calorie maple syrup and vanilla.
Stir in the oats, protein powder, grated carrot, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and baking powder until combined.
Pour into a lined baking dish and bake for about 30 minutes, until set. Let it cool.
Blend the cottage cheese, Greek yogurt, maple syrup, vanilla and cinnamon until completely smooth and creamy.
Spread the frosting over the cooled oats, scatter with chopped walnuts and a little cinnamon, and cut into 4 slices.
recipes.notes: 457 cal and 34 g protein per slice as stated. The video gives no amounts (full recipe is in the creator's paid hub), so ingredient quantities, carbs and fat are estimates sized to match the stated calories. Keeps in the fridge for 3–4 days.

recipes.title: Low-Carb Almond Flour Waffles
steps: Add the almond milk, almond flour, sweetener, eggs, baking powder, vanilla and salt to a blender or Magic Bullet and blend into a smooth, pourable batter.
Preheat a waffle maker and grease it lightly if it isn't non-stick.
Pour in enough batter to cover the plates, close and cook until the light says it's done and the waffles are golden, about 4–5 minutes.
Lift out gently (almond flour waffles are softer when hot and firm up as they cool). Serve with berries, sugar-free syrup or butter.
recipes.notes: The video is silent with no amounts on screen; it shows almond milk, Kirkland blanched almond flour, Whole Earth erythritol–monk fruit sweetener and vanilla going into a blender (eggs are assumed, as in any almond-flour waffle). Amounts and macros are estimates for a standard almond-flour waffle batter (makes one 4-square waffle, about 2 servings).

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Protein Cinnamon Buns
steps: In a bowl, mix the bread flour, sweetener, baking powder, baking soda and a pinch of salt.
Add the Greek yogurt and the egg yolk (the yolk keeps the buns rich and moist) and knead into a smooth dough ball.
Roll the dough out into a square about 1 in / 2.5 cm thick. Spread with the light butter, sprinkle the brown stevia over it and dust with cinnamon.
Slice into 6 equal strips and roll each one up into a bun. Place in a greased baking dish and press down gently.
Bake at 180°C / 350°F for 25–30 minutes, until golden. Let them cool.
Mix the light cream cheese, protein powder, vanilla and sweetener, adding water a little at a time until it's pourable. Push it through a sieve for a silky-smooth frosting.
Drizzle the frosting over the cooled buns, then pull apart and enjoy.
recipes.notes: All amounts are from the video's on-screen text; 20 g protein per bun is stated. Calories, carbs and fat are estimates.

recipes.title: Baked Sausage & Veggie Egg Breakfast Bowls

items.i: diced bell pepper, onion and tomato
cooked chicken or pork sausage link, sliced

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F / 190°C. Line up 4 oven-safe glass meal-prep bowls on a sheet pan.
Pour the liquid eggs into each bowl, then add the cottage cheese, shredded cheddar and diced veggies.
Season each bowl, then top with the sliced sausage.
Bake for 25–30 minutes, until the eggs are puffed and set in the middle and golden on top.
Sprinkle with green onion. Cool, lid and refrigerate for up to 4 days; reheat in the microwave for 1–2 minutes.
recipes.notes: The video has no narration or amounts; it shows liquid eggs, a white dairy scoop (cottage cheese), shredded cheddar, diced peppers/onion/tomato, seasoning and sliced sausage layered into glass bowls and baked. Amounts and macros are estimates per bowl.

recipes.title: Sticky Garlic Beef, Broccoli & Jasmine Rice Meal Prep

items.i: salt and ground white pepper, to taste
large head broccoli, florets and stem trimmed

steps: Add the washed rice, cold water and a pinch of salt to a saucepan over high heat. Once it boils, put the lid on, turn the heat to low and cook for 12 minutes. Take it off the heat and leave the lid on for another 4 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Cut the florets to an even size and chop the stem (peel it if you like). Steam over boiling water, lid on, for 5–6 minutes.
Whisk the soy sauce, honey, grated garlic and a little white pepper until the honey is mixed through.

Heat a large pan or wok over high heat until lightly smoking, add the oil, then the beef. Let it sit for a minute before breaking it up, and cook 6–7 minutes until no longer pink and all the released water has evaporated. Season lightly (the soy is salty).
Pour in the sauce and cook 1–2 minutes until it turns sticky and coats the beef. Stir through the steamed broccoli.
Divide the rice and beef between five 750 ml containers. Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 3 months in the freezer.
recipes.notes: Amounts and the per-container macros (584 cal, 51 g protein, 63 g carbs, 14 g fat) are from the creator. Add a splash of dark soy sauce for a darker colour.

recipes.title: Crispy Parmesan Air Fryer Chickpeas

items.i: can chickpeas (15 oz / 400 g), drained, rinsed and patted dry
spices of choice (e.g. smoked paprika, garlic powder)

steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then pat them very dry with a towel (dry chickpeas get crunchier).
Put them in a bowl, spray with oil and toss with the salt, spices and Parmesan.
Air fry at 200°C / 390°F for 15–18 minutes, shaking the basket every 5 minutes, until deep golden and crunchy. Or bake at 200°C / 400°F for 25–30 minutes.
Let them cool for a few minutes; they crisp up more as they cool. Best eaten the same day.
recipes.notes: A savory, crunchy snack that keeps you full. The reviewer said they taste more like potato than chickpeas. No amounts are given in the video, so quantities and macros are estimates for one can.

recipes.title: Triple Meat Stuffed-Crust Protein Pizza

items.i: slices center-cut bacon, cooked and chopped

steps: Mix the flour and Greek yogurt in a bowl, then knead into a smooth dough ball (dust with a little flour if sticky).
Roll the dough into a large round on parchment. Scatter the fat-free cheese around the edge, then fold the edge over the cheese and press to seal.
Meanwhile, break up the chicken sausage (pulse it in a chopper if you like) and brown it in a non-stick pan.
Spread the pizza sauce over the crust, then add the mozzarella, turkey pepperoni, bacon and cooked sausage.
Bake another 8–10 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the crust is golden. Cut into 8 slices.
recipes.notes: Amounts are from the video's on-screen text. Stated: 156 cal and 20 g protein per slice; 4 servings of 2 slices (312 cal, 40 g protein). Carbs, fat and the second bake time are estimates. Fit flour is a higher-protein flour; self-rising flour works too but adds a little less protein.

recipes.title: Crispy Chicken & High-Protein Mac and Cheese with Chilli Yogurt

items.i: chicken breast (3 large), butterflied and halved

steps: Butterfly each chicken breast and cut it in half to make 6 even fillets. Toss with the onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, a pinch of salt and plenty of pepper.
Mix the Greek yogurt with the chilli sauce, salt and pepper. Put it in a squeeze bottle or small containers and refrigerate (don't reheat it).
Spread the panko on a tray. Whisk the eggs in a bowl. Dip each fillet in egg, then press it into the panko until fully coated. No flour needed.
Place on a lined, oiled tray and spray the chicken thoroughly with oil on both sides. Bake at 220°C / 390°F (or air fry) for 18–20 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and 74°C / 165°F inside.
Cook the macaroni in well-salted boiling water for 1 minute less than the packet says, then drain.
Gently warm the milk over medium heat (don't let it simmer). Add the cheddar, mozzarella and cheese slices and stir gently until melted, then stir in the Dijon and a pinch of salt.
Fold the drained macaroni through the sauce until creamy and stringy, and season with pepper.
Slice the chicken into strips. Divide the mac and cheese between 5 containers, top with the chicken, and add the chilli yogurt and parsley when serving.
recipes.notes: Amounts and the per-container macros (736 cal, 70 g protein, 65 g carbs, 15 g fat) are from the creator. You'll have one fillet left over across 5 containers; either share it out or make 6 smaller portions.

recipes.title: Beyond Meat Breakfast Burritos

items.i: package (340 g) Beyond Meat ground beef (or lean ground beef)

steps: Cook the Beyond Meat with the red onion in a pan, breaking it up, until browned.
Whisk the eggs with the blended cottage cheese, salt, garlic powder and paprika. Scramble low and slow, stirring almost constantly, so they stay light and fluffy. Stir in the chives.
Lay out each tortilla and add the eggs, then the meat filling and a little cilantro crema.
Fold the bottom over the filling and tuck it in really tightly, fold in the sides, then roll it up.
Air fry for about 5 minutes until golden and crispy. To meal prep, wrap and freeze, then reheat in the air fryer.
recipes.notes: Ingredients and macros from the video description; directions from the video.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chunk Oat Bake

items.i: Nutella, melted with a little water, to drizzle (optional)

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F / 175°C. Mash the ripe bananas, then mix in everything else except the chocolate chunks until it forms a thick batter (pure pumpkin works instead of banana).
Fold in the chocolate chunks and spread evenly in a 9 × 5 in loaf pan sprayed with cooking spray.
Bake for 30–35 minutes, until a fork comes out clean.
Cut into 6 pieces and eat warm. For extra decadence, drizzle with Nutella loosened with a splash of water in the microwave.
recipes.notes: Ingredients and macros (per 2 pieces, without the Nutella drizzle) from the video description. The oven temperature isn't given, so 350°F is a typical setting.

recipes.title: Blueberry Swirl Oat Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F / 175°C. Mix the oats, mashed banana, protein powder, milk, baking powder, maple syrup and monkfruit, and spread evenly in a sprayed 9 × 5 in loaf pan.
Microwave the frozen blueberries for about a minute and scatter them over the batter.
Mix the Greek yogurt with the vanilla, dollop it on top and swirl it through with a knife.
Bake for 35–40 minutes (a little longer than the chocolate version), until set.
Cut into 6 pieces. Optional: drizzle with zero-calorie powdered sugar mixed with a little water, or serve with peanut butter.
recipes.notes: Ingredients and macros (per 2 pieces) from the video description. The oven temperature isn't given, so 350°F is a typical setting.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Oat Flour Waffles (No Protein Powder)

items.i: sugar-free maple syrup and whipped cream

steps: Blend all the batter ingredients until smooth.
Spray both plates of a hot waffle maker, add batter without overfilling, and cook until golden. Check rather than trusting the light so they don't overcook. Repeat with the rest.
Stack and top with sugar-free maple syrup and whipped cream. Works as pancakes too if you don't have a waffle maker.
recipes.notes: Ingredients and macros (whole stack, without toppings) from the video description; 46 g protein with no protein powder.

recipes.title: Chocolate Biscoff Egg White Oatmeal (No Protein Powder)

items.i: Biscoff spread (or peanut butter), loosened with a little water

steps: Cook the oats, cocoa, sweetener and almond milk in a small pot over medium heat.
Slowly stir in the egg whites and keep stirring constantly over low heat until the oats thicken and the whites are fully cooked (don't let them scramble).
Stir in the mashed banana, then fold through the cottage cheese without blending it, for texture.
Drizzle with Biscoff loosened with a little water and top with fruit.
recipes.notes: Ingredients and macros (whole recipe, without fruit) from the video description. The detailed cooking directions were on screen; these are the standard steps for egg-white oats.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Sausage, Egg & Cheese Breakfast Sandwich

items.i: vegan breakfast sausage patty (e.g. Gardein maple)

steps: Cook the sausage patty in the air fryer (or a pan) according to the package, and toast the English muffin.
Whisk the egg, egg whites, nutritional yeast, garlic powder and salt. Cook in a small greased pan over medium-low heat (not too high) as a round patty, flipping once.
Lay the cheddar on the egg so it melts.
Spread the muffin with BBQ sauce and stack the sausage, egg and cheese inside, McMuffin-style.
recipes.notes: Ingredients and macros from the video description; directions from the video.

recipes.title: White Chocolate French Toast

items.i: slices white bread (or bread of choice)

steps: Whisk the eggs, egg whites, vanilla, sweetener and cinnamon in a shallow container.
Dunk each slice so it soaks up the mixture without going soggy; pour any leftover over the bread.
Cook both slices together in a greased non-stick pan over medium heat until golden on both sides.
Top with the sugar-free maple syrup and white chocolate chips so they melt slightly.
recipes.notes: Ingredients and macros from the video description; directions from the video.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cottage Cheese Pancakes (No Protein Powder)

items.i: sugar-free maple syrup and whipped cream

steps: Blend everything until smooth, shaking the blender if the flour sticks at the top.
Heat a pan over low-medium heat and spray it. Pour in pancakes and cook until small bubbles pop on top, then flip carefully. Don't press them with the spatula.
Stack and top with sugar-free maple syrup and whipped cream.
recipes.notes: Ingredients and macros (whole stack, without toppings) from the video description; over 40 g protein with no protein powder.

recipes.title: Milk Chocolate Overnight Oats with Ganache
steps: Mix all the oat ingredients in a container.
Mix the ganache ingredients until completely smooth with no cocoa lumps. Add the milk gradually — it should be thick, not runny.
Spread the ganache over the oats and sprinkle with the mini chocolate chips.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight so the oats soak up the liquid.
recipes.notes: Ingredients and macros from the video description; directions from the video.

recipes.title: Frittata Breakfast Bagel

items.i: vegan breakfast sausage patty, torn up

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F / 190°C. Whisk the egg and egg whites, then stir in the onion, spinach, torn-up sausage patty and cheddar.
Pour into a small greased round ramekin or dish about the size of the bagel and bake for about 20 minutes, until set.
Toast the bagel (the air fryer works) until well done.
Slide the frittata into the bagel and add a little sugar-free BBQ sauce or light margarine if you like.
recipes.notes: Ingredients and macros from the video description. The bake temperature and time aren't given, so they're typical values for a single-serve frittata.

recipes.title: Beef & Cheesy Egg Breakfast Burritos

items.i: sauce of choice (not in the macros)

steps: Crack the 12 eggs into a bowl and whisk until smooth (don't season yet). Grate the cheddar.

Heat a large pan over medium-high heat with spray oil. Add the beef, let it sit a minute to brown, then break it up and cook 5–6 minutes with a pinch of salt and pepper, until no longer pink and the liquid has evaporated.
Add the smoked paprika, cumin, onion powder, garlic powder, oregano, thyme, diced tomatoes and a splash of water. Cook 2–2½ minutes until slightly reduced. Move to a bowl.

In the same pan over medium heat, melt the butter and add the eggs. Gently fold for 2–3 minutes for big soft curds; take them off while still slightly underdone. Season with salt and white pepper, then stir in the cheese off the heat to melt.
Lay out the wraps. Add about 125 g beef mix and 120 g egg to each, a little sauce and pepper, then roll up tightly with the seam underneath.
Place on a lined tray, spray with oil and bake at 200°C / 390°F for about 15 minutes until golden and crunchy (or air fry).
Wrap tightly in foil or bags. Keeps 3 days in the fridge or 3 months frozen; defrost overnight and reheat in the oven or air fryer until hot in the middle.
recipes.notes: Amounts and the per-burrito nutrition (600 cal, 53 g protein, 35 g carbs, 23 g fat, 8 g fiber, 3 g sugar) are from the creator. Swap the beef for pork, chicken or turkey if you like.

recipes.title: Creamy Watermelon Yogurt Cooler

items.i: lime, juiced, plus a wedge to garnish
ice cubes, plus more (pebble ice is best) to serve

steps: Add the watermelon, Greek yogurt, lime juice, honey, a pinch of salt and the ice cubes to a blender and blend until smooth and frothy.
Pour into glasses full of ice and garnish with a lime wedge.
recipes.notes: The original recipe gives no amounts, so these are estimates. The reviewer said it doesn't taste like Gatorade, more like a creamy watermelon creamsicle or sorbet. Try coconut milk instead of yogurt, or add matcha.

recipes.title: Cheesy Taco Egg & Rice Scramble
steps: Cook the rice with the water (he microwaves it for about 4 minutes; cook until tender).
Melt a little light butter in a pan, add the eggs and egg whites, season with salt and pepper, and stir as they cook into a soft scramble.
Add the hot rice to the pan, then the Greek yogurt, mozzarella, taco seasoning, Taco Bell sauce and lime juice.
Toss everything together until the cheese melts, then eat straight away.
recipes.notes: Amounts and macros (625 cal, 63 g protein, 63 g carbs, 15 g fat) are from the creator's description; the Greek yogurt is mentioned in the video but not the description. Fast-digesting and good for energy in the morning.

recipes.title: Tallow Eggs, Avocado Rice Cakes & Açaí Smoothie
steps: Heat a pan to medium, melt the tallow and fry the eggs to your liking.
Halve and pit the avocado, mash it with a little salt and spread it over the rice cakes.
Plate the eggs with the avocado rice cakes.
Blend the açaí, banana, mango, mango nectar and coconut cream until smooth and pour into a glass.
recipes.notes: A big, energy-dense breakfast. The video gives no amounts; quantities and macros (for everything, eggs plus smoothie) are estimates. Drop the smoothie or use fewer eggs for a lighter meal.

recipes.title: Beef, Cream Cheese & Green Chile Burritos

items.i: can (4 oz) mild diced green chiles
light sour cream and taco sauce (optional)

steps: Put the beef in a large pan, mash it up, and add the garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika and salt. Mix well.
Cook over medium-high heat for 8–10 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Turn the heat down, add the cream cheese and stir until it melts into the beef. Stir in the whole can of green chiles, then half the bag of shredded cheese.
Divide the filling between 8 tortillas (add light sour cream or taco sauce if you like) and fold them up tightly.
Toast the burritos seam-side down in a hot pan, turning to crisp the sides. Store in the fridge or wrap and freeze.
recipes.notes: 300 cal and 30 g protein per burrito, 8 burritos, as stated in the video (amounts from the video). The description version uses 12 wraps and adds sour cream and taco sauce. Carbs and fat are estimates.

recipes.title: Peri Peri Chicken & Spicy Rice Meal Prep

items.i: boneless, skinless chicken breasts, halved horizontally
Nando's peri peri sauce, plus extra to serve

steps: Butterfly and halve the chicken into 6 fillets. Toss with the garlic powder, smoked paprika, cumin, chilli flakes, peri peri sauce, salt and pepper. Use straight away or marinate up to 48 hours.
Melt the butter in a large saucepan over high heat. Add the onion, bell pepper and a pinch of salt and sauté 3–4 minutes until soft but not coloured.
Add the garlic and tomato paste and cook 2 minutes.
Add the rice, stock, smoked paprika, turmeric, oregano, chilli powder, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, stir once, then cover and cook on low for 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, sear the chicken in a hot oiled pan in batches, 2½–3 minutes per side, until just cooked through with good colour. Rest 5–10 minutes, then slice.
Stir the frozen peas and coriander into the rice and fluff it up.
Divide between five 750 ml containers, top with the sliced chicken and resting juices, drizzle with more peri peri sauce and garnish with coriander. Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 4 months frozen.
recipes.notes: Amounts and the per-portion nutrition (400 g portion: 569 cal, 47 g protein, 56 g carbs, 15 g fat) are from the creator. Use a mild sauce and skip the chilli powder to keep it gentle.

recipes.title: Blueberry Dark Chocolate Protein Yogurt Bowl
steps: Stir the Greek yogurt, blueberries and whey protein together in a bowl, adding a splash of milk to loosen it to a smooth, ice-cream-like texture. Frozen blueberries turn it purple and extra cold.
Scatter over the chopped dark chocolate and drizzle with honey.
recipes.notes: The video gives the yogurt (200 g) and blueberry (100 g) amounts; the other quantities and the macros are estimates.

recipes.title: High-Protein Marry Me Chicken Pasta

items.i: chicken stock (180 ml), plus extra to loosen
Parmigiano Reggiano, grated (50 g), plus extra to serve

steps: Put a pot of water on to boil. Dice the chicken and toss with the Italian herbs, a big pinch of salt and plenty of pepper.
Blend the cottage cheese, chicken stock, onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, Parmesan, sun-dried tomatoes, salt and pepper until completely smooth.
Salt the boiling water and cook the pasta for 3 minutes less than the packet says, then drain.

Heat the sun-dried tomato oil in a large high-sided pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken, let it sit 1–2 minutes to brown, then cook 5–6 minutes total until just cooked through (in batches if crowded).
Turn the heat to low, add the pasta and the sauce and stir gently for about 2 minutes. Keep it low or the sauce will split.
Stir in the spinach for about a minute until wilted. Season, and loosen with a splash of stock if you like it saucier.
Divide between five 750 ml containers (about 450 g each) and top with extra Parmesan and pepper. Keeps 3 days in the fridge or 3 months frozen.
recipes.notes: Amounts and per-portion nutrition (650 cal, 64 g protein, 68 g carbs, 11 g fat) are from the creator. Cottage cheese replaces the cream in the classic version: more protein and less fat, with very similar flavour.

recipes.title: Ham, Cheese & Pickle Panini

items.i: slices white sandwich bread (about 60 cal each)

steps: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat with half the oil. Toast the bread 60–90 seconds, moving it around, until golden; add the rest of the oil and flip.
Spread mustard on one slice and top with the ham and pickles; lay the cheese on the other slice.
After another minute, add a splash of water and cover the pan; the steam melts the cheese in about 20 seconds.
Close the sandwich and serve (about 4 minutes in total).
recipes.notes: Ingredients and macros from the video description.

recipes.title: Savory French Toast Chicken & Mozzarella Sandwich
steps: Whisk the egg, egg whites, oregano, paprika, a strong pinch of salt and pepper (or use 100 g egg whites or 2 eggs).
Dunk both bread slices in the egg, flipping until they've soaked up most of it.
Cook in the oil over medium heat 2–3 minutes per side, pouring any leftover egg into the pan so it sticks to the bread.
Top with the deli chicken, mozzarella and light mayo if using, close and flip once or twice until the cheese melts.
recipes.notes: Ingredients and macros from the video description.

recipes.title: Caprese Toast Sandwich

items.i: light fresh mozzarella, sliced ½ cm thick
salt, black pepper and dried oregano

steps: Toast the bread in the olive oil over medium heat until golden on both sides, then remove from the pan.
Top with the mozzarella slices (served cold, since fresh mozzarella doesn't melt well), then the tomato.
Salt the tomatoes (don't skip it), add pepper and oregano, a drizzle of balsamic glaze and fresh basil, then close.
recipes.notes: Ingredients and macros from the video description.

recipes.title: Tuna, Avocado & Olive Sandwich Spread
steps: Add the tuna, cream cheese, avocado, lemon juice, chopped olives, salt and pepper to a bowl.
Slowly mash the avocado and mix until it turns into a creamy tuna salad.
Spread on toasted sandwich bread (stack 3–4 slices for a double-decker), or eat it on its own.
recipes.notes: Ingredients from the video description. The macros (357 cal, 39 g protein) are for the whole tuna spread without bread; the creator puts a sandwich serving at about 290 cal with 17 g protein.

recipes.title: Fluffy Cottage Cheese Ring Pancakes with Air-Fried Banana

items.i: sugar-free maple syrup, plus extra to serve

steps: Blend the cottage cheese, eggs, vanilla and sugar-free maple syrup until smooth, then mix in the self-rising flour.

Heat a greased pan over medium heat with greased metal muffin/egg rings. Fill the rings with batter and cook low and slow until set and golden underneath, then flip (ring and all) and finish the other side. This is what makes them extra tall and fluffy.
Sprinkle the banana halves with cinnamon and air fry until caramelised.
Stack the pancakes, drizzle with sugar-free syrup and top with the bananas.
recipes.notes: Amounts and per-pancake macros (135 cal, 9 g protein, 17.5 g carbs, 3.25 g fat; recipe makes 8) are from the creator's description.

recipes.title: 3-Ingredient Berry Cottage Cheese Ice Cream

items.i: coconut or dark chocolate, to top (optional)

steps: Blend the cottage cheese, blueberries, raspberries and honey until completely smooth and liquid.
Pour into a medium freezer-safe bowl or container, spread it out evenly and freeze for at least 1½ hours.
Let it sit at room temperature for 10 minutes so it's easy to scoop.
Scoop into bowls and top with coconut or dark chocolate if you like. Also good for breakfast or on a healthy crumble.
recipes.notes: Amounts from the video; macros are estimates. Any fruit works in place of the berries.

recipes.title: Onion & Pecorino Romano Spaghetti

items.i: Pecorino Romano, grated, plus extra to serve
salt and plenty of black pepper

steps: Thinly slice the onions. Cook them in the olive oil with a pinch of salt over medium-low heat until very soft.
Add the butter and black pepper and keep cooking until golden and caramelised, then add the garlic for a minute.
Pour in the stock, grate in the Pecorino, then blitz everything in a blender until smooth.
Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Add the spaghetti to a pan with a splash of pasta water and the onion sauce and toss until glossy and creamy, adjusting with more water or sauce.
Finish with more Pecorino and black pepper.
recipes.notes: Adapted by the creator from a Thomas Straker recipe. The video gives no amounts, so quantities and macros are estimates. Use vegetable stock to keep it vegetarian.

recipes.title: High-Protein Beef & Veggie Cottage Cheese Lasagna

items.i: cans (15 oz / 425 g) tomato sauce, plus ½ can water
dried parsley, plus extra to garnish
low-moisture part-skim mozzarella, shredded (1 cup goes in the cheese mix)
Parmigiano Reggiano, shredded (½ cup goes in the cheese mix)

steps: Dice the zucchini, carrots, bell pepper and mushrooms to a similar size; mince the garlic and shallot separately. Heat the oven to 400°F / 204°C.
Add the tomato sauce, water, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, pepper, oregano and basil to a pot and simmer covered on low.
Brown the beef with the salt over medium heat, adding the garlic and shallot as it finishes. Stir into the sauce and cover.
In the same pan, cook the mushrooms first to release their moisture, then the other veggies until slightly softened. Stir into the sauce and turn off the heat.
Whisk or blend the cottage cheese with the cornstarch, then whisk in the eggs, parsley, 1 cup mozzarella and ½ cup Parmesan. Mix the remaining shredded cheeses for the top.

In a 9 × 13 in glass dish (set on a foil-lined sheet), layer a third of the sauce and cheese mix, noodles, another third of each, noodles, the last of the sauce and cheese mix, then the cheese topping.
Tent loosely with foil and bake 30 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 minutes more, then raise to 450°F / 230°C for 5–10 minutes until the top is browned to your liking.
Cool for 15 minutes before slicing; garnish with parsley.
recipes.notes: Full recipe and macros from the creator's description. Whole lasagna: 6,256 cal, 571 g protein, 467 g carbs, 229 g fat. Per serving it's 782 cal / 71 g protein for 8 servings, 626 cal / 57 g for 10 (shown here), or 521 cal / 47.5 g for 12.

recipes.title: Traditional Ragù Bolognese with Garlic Bread

items.i: mixed beef, veal and pork mince
passata (tomato sauce), plus ½ bottle of water

steps: Cook the pancetta in a large pan over medium heat for 4–5 minutes until the fat renders and it's golden (no salt needed).
Add the onion, celery and carrot with a little salt and sauté 6–7 minutes, stirring, without letting them colour.
Turn the heat to medium-high, add the mince, let it sit a minute or two, then break it up and cook 8–10 minutes until no longer pink and the water has evaporated. Season.
Pour in the red wine and reduce by about 75%, 2–3 minutes, scraping up the browned bits.
Stir in the tomato paste, passata and the half bottle of water used to rinse it out. Bring to a simmer, check seasoning, then cook on low for at least 2 hours (up to 5). He cooked it 3.
Mix the butter, grated garlic, parsley, salt and pepper. Slice the bread almost all the way through, spread the butter between the slices, and bake 10–15 minutes while the pasta cooks.
About 20 minutes before the end, cook the pasta in salted water for 1 minute less than the packet says. Reserve some pasta water, then drain.
Stir the milk gently into the ragù over low heat. It balances the acidity and makes it creamy; don't let it boil or it can split.

Toss each serving of pasta in a pan with a couple of ladles of ragù and a splash of pasta water over higher heat. Add Parmesan, torn basil and pepper, then pile high with extra sauce and Parmesan on top.
recipes.notes: Amounts are from the video; the ragù freezes well, so make extra. No macros are given, so they're estimates per serving (with pasta, without garlic bread).

recipes.title: Moroccan Spiced Lamb Cutlets with Spiced Yogurt

items.i: salt, cracked black pepper and sea salt flakes
fresh coriander (cilantro), chopped, plus extra to garnish
fresh mint, chopped, plus extra to garnish

steps: Mix the smoked paprika, cumin, coriander, cloves, allspice and cayenne. Set 1 tbsp aside for the yogurt.
Toss the lamb cutlets with the rest of the spice blend, the olive oil, salt and pepper until fully coated.
Mix the Greek yogurt with the reserved spice blend, coriander, mint, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Refrigerate until serving.
Heat a charcoal barbecue or gas grill (or a griddle pan) to about 240°C / 470°F.
Grill the cutlets about 3 minutes per side for medium-rare (about 50°C / 122°F inside), rotating halfway on each side for crosshatch marks. Keep the lid closed between turns.
Rest 5 minutes, then arrange on a platter with the spiced yogurt, chopped coriander and mint, and a pinch of sea salt flakes.
recipes.notes: Amounts are from the video. The spice blend is also great on chicken, fish or beef. Macros are estimates.

recipes.title: Creamy Spiced Steak Pasta Meal Prep

items.i: olive or avocado oil (or spray oil)
lean steak (topside, skirt, flank, sirloin), thinly sliced across the grain
Parmigiano Reggiano, grated, and cracked black pepper

steps: Put a pot of water on to boil. Slice the steak thinly across the grain (20–30 minutes in the freezer makes this easier) and season with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large high-sided pan over high heat. Sear the steak in batches for 2–2½ minutes until browned but not cooked through, then set aside.
Salt the water and cook the pasta 1 minute less than the packet says.
In the same pan over medium-high heat, melt the butter and cook the garlic for 1 minute, stirring so it doesn't burn. Deglaze with the stock for 1 minute.
Add the evaporated milk, smoked paprika and chilli. Bring to a simmer, season, then reduce to low for 5–6 minutes until slightly thickened.
Stir in the spinach for 1½–2 minutes until wilted, then add the steak and its juices.
Transfer the pasta to the sauce with a little pasta water and cook 1 minute over medium-high heat until coated.
Divide into 6 containers (about 400 g each), top with Parmesan, parsley and pepper. Keeps 3 days in the fridge or 4 months frozen; reheat in the microwave.
recipes.notes: Amounts and per-container nutrition (659 cal, 47 g protein, 63 g carbs, 24 g fat, 4 g fibre, 6 g sugar) are from the creator. Evaporated milk keeps it lighter than cream.

recipes.title: Loaded BBQ Chicken Potatoes Meal Prep

items.i: boneless, skinless chicken breast, diced bite-size
BBQ sauce (125 g), plus extra to drizzle

steps: Toss the diced potatoes with the onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, oregano, thyme, olive oil, salt and pepper. Air fry at 200°C / 390°F for about 22 minutes (or roast in the oven) until golden and tender.
Toss the diced chicken with the grated garlic, onion powder, smoked paprika, oregano, thyme, salt and pepper. Grate the mozzarella.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken, spread out and leave 1–1½ minutes to build a crust, then cook 5–6 minutes total until just cooked through.
Add the BBQ sauce and cook about a minute until thick and glossy.
Add the potatoes and toss to coat, then turn the heat to low.
Scatter most of the mozzarella over the top, cover and cook 1–1½ minutes until melted.
Divide between 5 containers (about 400 g each) and top with the rest of the mozzarella, extra BBQ sauce and parsley if you like. Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge or 3 months frozen.
recipes.notes: Amounts are from the video; per-container nutrition (680 cal, 59 g protein, 58 g carbs, 20 g fat, 22 g fibre, 10 g sugar) is from the creator's card. The extra BBQ drizzle and parsley aren't included.

recipes.title: Korean Gochujang Chicken Rice Bowls with Cucumber Salad

items.i: ground white pepper and cooking spray
spring onion, thinly sliced (white for the salad, green to garnish)

steps: Mix the sliced cucumber with the gochujang, 2 grated garlic cloves, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, gochugaru, sesame oil, the sliced spring onion whites, a little salt and white pepper. Refrigerate.
Mix the chicken with the soy sauce, gochujang, sriracha, sesame oil, the remaining garlic, the ginger and white pepper. Use straight away or marinate up to 48 hours.
Spread the chicken and all the marinade on a lined, lightly oiled tray and bake at 200°C / 390°F for 20–22 minutes (or air fry), until cooked and caramelised. Rest 5 minutes, then dice.
Bring the rice, water and a pinch of salt to a boil, then cover and cook on low for 12 minutes. Leave covered off the heat for 4 minutes, then fluff with the sesame seeds.

Divide the rice, chicken (with the pan juices) and cucumber salad between 5 containers and garnish with spring onion greens and sesame seeds. Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 4 months frozen (store the cucumbers separately if freezing).
recipes.notes: Amounts are from the creator's description; per-container nutrition (440 g: 579 cal, 46 g protein, 67 g carbs, 12 g fat) is from his card.

recipes.title: Foolproof Cacio e Pepe

items.i: Pecorino Romano, freshly grated (about 1½ cups), plus extra to serve
black peppercorns, coarsely cracked (60–70 grinds), plus extra to serve

steps: Bring a smaller-than-usual pot of water to a boil (less water means more starch). Season lightly with salt.
Cook the spaghetti for 2 minutes less than the packet says.
Meanwhile, toast the cracked pepper in a dry pan over medium heat for about 2 minutes until fragrant, without burning.
Turn the pepper pan to low, add 2–2½ ladles of starchy pasta water, then simmer over medium-high for about 2 minutes, scraping in any pepper from the sides.
Add the spaghetti with a little more pasta water and turn the heat OFF.
Add all the Pecorino and toss quickly so the residual heat melts it into a creamy sauce. Freshly grated cheese is key; pre-grated has anti-caking agents that make it clump.
Loosen with more pasta water to the consistency you like, using a little low heat only if needed to bring it together.
Serve in bowls with extra Pecorino and cracked pepper.
recipes.notes: Amounts are from the video; serves 2 generously (or 3 smaller portions). Macros are estimates.

recipes.title: Chilli Lime Chicken & Coriander Rice Bowls
steps: Toss the diced chicken with the onion powder, smoked paprika, cumin, chilli, garlic, 10 g coriander, lime zest and juice, plenty of salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a large pan over medium-high heat and sear the chicken 5–6 minutes (in batches if needed), letting it colour before stirring, until cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan over high heat, add the rice, stock and a pinch of salt, scraping up the chicken bits. Bring to a boil, cover and cook on low for 12 minutes, then rest covered 4 minutes off the heat.
Whisk the Greek yogurt, honey, 5 g coriander, garlic, lime juice, salt and white pepper. Refrigerate (a squeeze bottle makes it easy).
Fluff the rice and stir in the remaining 10 g coriander.
Divide the rice and chicken (with juices) between 5 containers. Add half an avocado and a drizzle of sauce to each after reheating. Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 3 months frozen.
recipes.notes: Amounts are from the video; per-container nutrition (664 cal, 54 g protein, 57 g carbs, 21 g fat, 6 g fibre) is from the creator's card. Add the avocado and sauce fresh after reheating.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala with Turmeric Rice

items.i: high-protein or natural Greek yogurt (130 g)

steps: Mix the chicken with the grated garlic, ginger, Kashmiri chilli, turmeric, garam masala, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Heat the peanut oil in a large pan over high heat and sear the chicken in two batches, about 5 minutes each, until golden and lightly charred but not cooked through. Set aside.
Melt the ghee in a large pot over medium-high heat and fry the onion and bell pepper with a pinch of salt for 5–6 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the cumin seeds, garam masala, Kashmiri chilli, paprika and ground coriander and cook 30–45 seconds.
Stir in the tomato paste, turn to medium and cook 3–4 minutes to bring out its oils and depth.

Turn up to medium-high, return the chicken and juices, stir in the Greek yogurt and bring to a light simmer (about 2 minutes). Add the stock and a pinch of salt, bring to a boil, then simmer uncovered on low for 25–30 minutes until the chicken is tender and the gravy thick.
Bring the rice, stock, turmeric and a pinch of salt to a boil, cover and cook on low for 12 minutes, rest 4 minutes off the heat, then fluff in the 5 g coriander.
Stir the cream and remaining coriander into the curry and cook 2 more minutes; adjust seasoning.
Divide into 5 containers (about 200 g rice and 350 g curry each). Keeps 3 days in the fridge or 4 months frozen; reheat in a pan with a splash of stock.
recipes.notes: Amounts are from the creator's description; per-container nutrition (687 cal, 57 g protein, 71 g carbs, 23 g fat, 4 g fibre, 10 g sugar) is from his card. Use less cream to lighten it.

recipes.title: Fudgy Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Oat Bars

items.i: creamy peanut butter (or powdered peanut butter)
vanilla casein protein powder (or a whey/casein blend)

steps: Combine the oats, cocoa, peanut butter, protein powder and salt in a large bowl.
Stir in the milk, then add water a little at a time until it looks like thick Nutella with oats (casein needs more liquid than whey).
Line an 8 × 20 cm (about 3 × 8 in) tin with parchment paper and spread the mixture evenly.
Bake at 200°C / 400°F for 25 minutes. It will still feel a little jiggly.
Lift out, cool on a plate for about 20 minutes to firm up, then cut into 6 bars.
recipes.notes: Amounts and macros are from the video: the whole tray is 1,230 cal, 122 g carbs, 40 g fat and 89 g protein, about 205 cal and 15 g protein per bar. No added sugar; the milk sweetens it. Whey makes them drier, more like a protein bar.

recipes.title: Garlic Parmesan Steak Bites & Alfredo Pasta

items.i: each salt, pepper, Italian herbs, parsley and smoked paprika

steps: Toss the cubed steak with the salt, pepper, Italian herbs, parsley, garlic powder, smoked paprika and olive oil. Leave 30 minutes for more flavour.
Cook the steak in a little light butter over medium-high heat, about 2 minutes per side, until golden and juicy.
Lower the heat, add the rest of the butter, the garlic and Parmesan and toss for a minute until coated. Set aside.
Cook the pasta in salted water, reserving a little pasta water.
In the same pan, cook the onion and garlic over medium-low heat 5–6 minutes until soft, then add the extra seasoning for a minute.
Add the evaporated milk, cream cheese and Parmesan on low heat and stir until smooth. Let it bubble gently until thick, loosening with pasta water if needed.
Toss the cooked pasta through the sauce, then divide into 4 containers with the steak bites. Freezes well; reheat with a dash of milk.
recipes.notes: Amounts and per-serving macros (595 cal, 65 g protein, 50 g carbs, 15 g fat) are from the creator's description.

recipes.title: Spicy Chicken & Turmeric Rice with Tzatziki

items.i: flat-leaf parsley, chopped, plus extra to garnish

steps: Mix the chicken with the onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, cumin, chilli powder, salt, pepper and olive oil.
Heat a lightly oiled pan over medium-high heat and sear the chicken in batches for 6–7 minutes until cooked. Set aside.
In the same pan, melt the butter and toast the rice for 2 minutes to pick up the chicken flavour.
Add the turmeric, paprika, cumin, stock, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, cover and cook on low for 12 minutes. Leave covered off the heat for 4 minutes, then fluff.
Mix the Greek yogurt, squeezed cucumber, lemon juice, garlic, dill, parsley, salt and pepper.
Divide the rice and chicken between 5 containers (about 420 g each), drizzle with tzatziki (or pack it separately) and garnish with parsley. Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge or 4 months frozen.
recipes.notes: Recipe from the creator's description; per-container nutrition (556 cal, 53 g protein, 52 g carbs, 13 g fat) is from his card. It's only mildly spicy; skip the chilli for none.

recipes.title: Taco Chicken Potato Bowls with Pico de Gallo

items.i: each onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, ground cumin and dried oregano
boneless, skinless chicken breast, diced large
each onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, ground cumin and dried oregano
avocado or olive oil (1 for the marinade, 1 for cooking)
lime, zested, plus about 1 tsp juice
chipotle hot sauce (e.g. Cholula Chipotle), to taste

steps: Toss the diced potatoes with the spices, chilli, oil, salt and pepper.
In the same bowl, toss the diced chicken with the same spices, chilli flakes, 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper.
Mix the tomatoes, onion, jalapeño, coriander and lime juice with a pinch of salt. Refrigerate.
Mix the Greek yogurt, coriander, lime zest and juice and the chipotle sauce. Refrigerate (keeps a week).
Air fry the potatoes at 200°C / 390°F for 18–24 minutes until soft and golden (or roast in the oven).
Sear the chicken in batches in a hot oiled pan, leaving it 2 minutes to crust, then 5–6 minutes total until cooked through.
Per container: 150 g potatoes, 170 g chicken with juices. Add 80 g pico and 40 g sauce when serving (store them separately). Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 3 months frozen.
recipes.notes: Amounts and per-container nutrition (440 g: 438 cal, 46 g protein, 24 g carbs, 15 g fat) are from the creator. Keep the pico and sauce in separate containers and add after reheating.

recipes.title: Chipotle Cottage Cheese Alfredo with Crispy Chicken

items.i: taco seasoning, smoked paprika, garlic powder and salt

steps: Season the chicken thighs generously with taco seasoning, smoked paprika, garlic powder and salt. Air fry at 400°F / 200°C for 15–20 minutes until crispy and cooked through, then slice.
Cook the penne in salted water until al dente; reserve a splash of pasta water and drain.
Blend the cottage cheese, evaporated milk, Parmesan, chipotle, adobo, garlic powder, paprika, onion powder and salt until completely smooth.
Warm the sauce gently in the pasta pan, then toss in the penne, loosening with pasta water if needed.
Divide between 2 plates and top with the sliced chicken.
recipes.notes: Amounts and per-serving macros (625 cal, 63 g protein, 65 g carbs, 14 g fat; makes 2) are from the creator's description. Use half the chipotle for less heat.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Buffalo Chicken Chalupas

items.i: chicken breasts, patted dry and flattened (amount estimated)
part-skim mozzarella and 2% Colby Jack, shredded

steps: Pat the chicken dry, flatten it, and press ⅓ packet of ranch dip seasoning into both sides. Spray with avocado oil.
Air fry at 400°F / 200°C for 9–10 minutes until cooked through, then dice.
Blend the Greek yogurt, cottage cheese and Frank's RedHot until smooth, then toss with the diced chicken.
Lay a pita flat, add mozzarella and Colby Jack, the buffalo chicken and more cheese, then fold tightly.
Spray both sides with avocado oil and air fry at 400°F for about 4 minutes until crispy.
Open slightly and stuff with lettuce and tomato.
recipes.notes: Amounts from the on-screen captions; macros per chalupa are from the creator. The chicken amount and number of chalupas (4) are estimates.

recipes.title: Crispy Air Fryer Chicken Tenders with Garlic Parmesan Sauce

items.i: egg whites mixed with a splash of buffalo sauce
seasoning: sea salt, black pepper, onion powder, chilli powder
each black pepper, red pepper flakes, oregano and basil

steps: Wrap the garlic bulbs loosely in foil and bake at 400°F for 40–50 minutes until soft.
Set up three bowls: flour; egg whites with buffalo sauce; panko mixed with the seasoning.
Dredge each tender in flour, dip in the egg wash, then press into the panko (one dry hand, one wet hand keeps it tidy).
Spray both sides with cooking spray and air fry at 400°F / 200°C for 9 minutes until crispy.
Squeeze out the roasted garlic and mix (or blend) with the yogurt, vinegar, Parmesan, sweetener, red peppers, lemon juice and seasonings.
Dip the tenders in the sauce.
recipes.notes: Amounts from the on-screen captions; macros (75 cal, 11 g protein per tender) are from the creator. The whole sauce batch is 212 cal and 7 g protein. Chicken, flour and egg white amounts are estimates.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Crunchy Taco Pockets

items.i: chicken broth, plus a splash more

steps: Brown the beef, then add the taco seasoning and chicken broth. Stir in the Mexican cheese, Laughing Cow wedges and nutritional yeast until thick but not dry (add more broth if needed).
Mix the flour with a little water into a paste.
Cut each tortilla in half. Fold one side over, glue under the fold and press to make a cone.
Spoon in filling, press it down, glue the top edge, fold shut and crimp with a fork. Repeat for all 10.
Spray with cooking spray and air fry at 400°F / 200°C for 4–5 minutes until golden.
recipes.notes: Amounts from the on-screen captions; macros per pocket (10 total) are from the creator. The cheese amount is an estimate.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Jalapeño Popper Chicken Hot Pockets

items.i: chicken tenders, seasoned with ranch dip mix

steps: Season the chicken tenders with ranch dip mix, cook them through, then chop finely.
Air fry the jalapeños at 400°F for 5–7 minutes, then remove the seeds and dice.
Mix the Greek yogurt, Laughing Cow wedges, roasted jalapeños and ¼ packet ranch, then fold in the chicken, cheese, black beans, corn and pico.

Brush the edges of a bread slice with egg white, add filling, top with a second slice brushed with egg white, press and crimp with a fork, then trim the crusts. Makes 4 (you'll have filling left over).
Air fry at 400°F / 200°C for 4–5 minutes until golden.
recipes.notes: Amounts from the on-screen captions; macros per hot pocket are from the creator. Jalapeño count, cheese and pico amounts are estimates.

recipes.title: Thick Cornflake-Crusted McChicken

items.i: garlic powder, black pepper, salt and paprika

steps: Mix the ground chicken with the mustard and seasonings and form 3 even balls.
Blend the corn flakes with garlic powder and paprika into crumbs and tip into a shallow bowl.
Press each ball into the crumbs and flatten into a thick patty.
Air fry at 400°F / 200°C for 10–12 minutes, flipping halfway.
Serve in buns with shredded lettuce and light mayo.
recipes.notes: Amounts from the on-screen captions; macros per sandwich (3 total) are from the creator.

recipes.title: Triple Chocolate Brownie Protein Pizookie

items.i: chocolate chips, melted, plus a few for the top
protein ice cream (e.g. Oreo protein Creami)

steps: Mix the protein powder, cocoa, flour, baking soda and salt so there are no clumps.
Add the syrup, egg, pumpkin (you won't taste it) and melted chocolate chips and mix into a thick brownie batter.
Spread into a 6½-inch cast-iron pan and scatter a few more chocolate chips on top.
Air fry at 300°F / 150°C for about 6 minutes; it should stay fudgy in the middle.
Top with scoops of protein ice cream and eat warm.
recipes.notes: Amounts from the on-screen captions; macros (whole pizookie) are from the creator and likely exclude the ice cream.

recipes.title: Crispy Spicy Chicken Burgers
steps: Slice the chicken breasts into 6 pieces and toss with the chicken seasoning.
Mix the flour with its seasonings and baking powder in one bowl; beat the eggs in another.
Dip each piece in egg, then press firmly into the seasoned flour. Shake off the excess, place on a lined tray or in the air fryer basket and spray lightly with oil.
Bake at 200°C / 390°F for 22–23 minutes, or air fry at 190°C / 375°F for 15–16 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and 74°C / 165°F inside.
Mix the mayonnaise, mustard powder, chopped pickle, onion powder, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Refrigerate.
Toast the buns if you like, spread sauce on both halves, add the chicken and top with lettuce just before eating. Wrap tightly in paper or foil to serve.
Keep the chicken (4 days in the fridge or 3 months frozen) and sauce (4 days) separately and build fresh. Reheat the chicken in the oven or air fryer for 6–8 minutes to re-crisp.
recipes.notes: Full recipe and per-burger nutrition (534 cal, 47 g protein, 30 g carbs, 19 g fat, 2 g fibre, 4 g sugar; makes 6) from the creator's website.

recipes.title: Creamy Mango Passion Fruit Drink
steps: Scoop the pulp from the passion fruits, blend for about 2 minutes, then strain to remove the seeds.
Blend the diced mango with the passion fruit juice, milk and condensed milk for about 2 minutes.
Pour over a big bowl of ice so it's very cold, then serve in glasses.
recipes.notes: Amounts are from the video; macros are estimates. Sweet and rich because of the condensed milk; use less or a light version to cut sugar.

recipes.title: Buffalo Philly Cheesesteak Protein Pizza
steps: Mix the flour and Greek yogurt into a dough and roll it out into a large round (or a deep pan).
Season the steak and sear it on high heat, then slice or shave it thinly.
Spread the buffalo blue cheese sauce over the crust, add the steak, cheese, onion and green pepper.
Bake for another 10 minutes until the cheese is melted and the crust golden. Cut into 8 slices.
recipes.notes: Crust amounts are from the video; the creator says the whole pizza is under 1,000 cal with over 130 g protein (about 120 cal and 17 g protein a slice). Topping amounts, carbs and fat are estimates; his full list was in a caption I couldn't see.

recipes.title: Triple Chocolate Protein Cinnamon Rolls
steps: Mix the flour, cocoa, baking powder, sweetener and salt, then add the Greek yogurt and knead into a smooth dough.
Roll out into a rectangle, spread with the sugar-free chocolate syrup, and sprinkle with cinnamon and mini chocolate chips.
Roll up tightly and cut into 6 rolls. Place in a lined loaf pan or baking dish.
Bake at 350°F / 175°C for 20 minutes, then cover with foil and bake 10 minutes more.
Whisk the Greek yogurt, whey, casein, cocoa and chocolate syrup into a thick frosting and spread over the warm rolls.
recipes.notes: Amounts and per-roll macros (185 cal, 16 g protein, 29 g carbs, 1 g fat; makes 6) are from the creator's description. The whole batch is about 96 g protein.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Steak Straight from Frozen

items.i: frozen steak (about 10 oz / 280 g, e.g. ribeye or sirloin)

steps: Rub the frozen steak (no thawing) with avocado oil.
Season the top with salt, pepper and garlic powder, flip, season the other side, and air fry 8 minutes more.
Check the temperature; flip and cook about 5 more minutes, or until it reaches your preferred doneness (130–135°F / 54–57°C for medium-rare).
Top with garlic herb butter, tent with foil and rest 5–10 minutes before slicing.
recipes.notes: Times are from the video (about 21 minutes total for his steak); thicker steaks need longer, so go by internal temperature. Steak size and macros are estimates.

recipes.title: Honey Butter Chicken Paninis (14 meal-prep sandwiches)

items.i: yogurt butter (or light butter, ~45 cal per serving)
thin-cut provolone slices (2 per sandwich, ~35 cal each)

steps: Toss the chicken thighs with the salt, pepper, paprika and garlic powder. Bake at 400°F (200°C) until the internal temperature reaches 160°F (71°C), then rest 5 minutes and chop.
Mix the softened yogurt butter with the honey and parsley.
Toss the sliced red onion with the red wine vinegar and honey.
Spread honey butter on the outside of each bread slice. Fill each sandwich with 2 provolone slices, chopped chicken and pickled onions.
Toast in a panini press or skillet until golden and the cheese melts.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros are the creator's (per sandwich). Commenters found the bread gets soggy after a day; for meal prep, store the chicken, onions and honey butter separately and assemble and toast each sandwich fresh.

recipes.title: High-Protein Cottage Cheese Garlic Naan (24 mini naans)

items.i: chopped parsley or cilantro, to finish

steps: Blend the cottage cheese in a food processor until completely smooth.
Mix the blended cottage cheese with the self-rising flour, salt and garlic paste and knead into a soft dough.
Roll into a log and cut into 24 even pieces.
Roll each piece out very thin, about 3.5–4 inches; they puff up a lot in the pan.
Cook in a hot dry skillet (cast iron works well) for 1–2 minutes per side until puffed and charred in spots. Sprinkle with herbs.
Cool, then freeze between sheets of parchment and reheat in a skillet or toaster.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros are the creator's, per mini naan. Make them bigger if you like, but the macros will change, so weigh them if you track.

recipes.title: Medjool Date Bark with Dark Chocolate & Peanut Butter

items.i: nuts of choice, chopped (pistachios shown; optional)

steps: Pulse the pitted dates in a food processor until they form a sticky paste, or flatten them by hand. Press into an even layer on a parchment-lined tray.
Spread the melted dark chocolate over the dates.
Drizzle with melted peanut butter, scatter with chopped nuts and finish with flaky sea salt.
Chill or freeze until firm, about 1 hour, then break into pieces. Keep in the fridge or freezer.
recipes.notes: Macros are the creator's approximate figures per piece; the number of pieces isn't given, so servings is estimated. Not low-calorie, as the creator says, but a minimally processed treat or pre-workout snack.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Beef (10 meal-prep servings)

items.i: trimmed flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Toss the sliced flank steak with the cornstarch, soy sauce, olive oil, garlic powder, pepper and salt.
Sear the beef in batches in a very hot pan or wok until browned at the edges; don't crowd the pan.
In the pan, simmer the honey, soy sauce, sweet chili sauce, rice vinegar, brown sugar blend, garlic, ginger, hoisin and chili flakes until glossy. Thicken with the cornstarch slurry if needed.
Return the beef and toss until coated and the sauce clings.
Divide into 10 containers over rice and top with sesame seeds and green onions.
recipes.notes: Ingredients and macros are the creator's, per serving without rice. His caption doesn't spell out the cooking steps, so the method is the standard one for this dish.

recipes.title: Tiramisu Overnight Oats with Protein Yogurt Topping

items.i: raw cacao powder, plus extra to dust
Oikos Triple Zero vanilla Greek yogurt

steps: Mix the oats, cacao powder, chia seeds and salt. Add the espresso, almond milk, 2 tbsp honey and 1 tsp vanilla and mix well. Transfer to a sealable glass container.
Whisk the protein powder, ½ tbsp honey and ¼ tsp vanilla into the yogurt.
Spread the yogurt over the oats and sift a little more cacao powder on top.
Refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight, then split into 2 servings.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros are the creator's, per serving (the container makes 2). Original recipe credited to @clairesharrynroberto.

recipes.title: Smoky Chipotle Chicken Wraps with Pineapple Salsa

items.i: each garlic powder and smoked paprika

steps: Toss the cubed chicken with the seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice and olive oil and marinate.
Blend the yogurt, mayo, chipotle paste, pineapple, seasonings, lime juice and evaporated milk until smooth. Bottle and refrigerate.
Mix the onion, peppers, pineapple, cilantro, honey and lime juice and refrigerate.
Spread the chicken on a large lined sheet pan without overcrowding. Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes, then broil 5 minutes until golden and crispy.
Toast a wrap, add hot chicken, cold salsa and sauce, and roll up.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros are the creator's, per wrap. For meal prep, keep the chicken, salsa, sauce and wraps separate and assemble fresh.

recipes.title: Fudgy Sweet Potato Brownies

items.i: medium sweet potato, roasted and mashed
oat flour (a little more if your sweet potato is big)
dark chocolate chips, plus extra for the top

steps: Roast the sweet potato at 425°F (220°C) for about 50 minutes until very soft, then peel and mash.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Mash the sweet potato in a large bowl and blend in the eggs, maple syrup and vanilla until smooth (an immersion blender works well).
Add the cacao powder, oat flour, salt and baking soda and mix until combined, then fold in the chocolate chips.
Pour into a parchment-lined baking dish, scatter more chips on top and bake for 30–45 minutes; the creator bakes hers 40 minutes. They stay soft and gooey, like chocolate pudding cake.
recipes.notes: Recipe is the creator's tweak of @wellwithkaija's; macros are estimated (12 squares). Some commenters found ¼ tsp salt too salty, so start with a pinch. The video also mentions adding honey, which isn't in her written recipe.

recipes.title: Crispy Rice Paper Beef Protein Bites with Spicy Peanut Sauce

items.i: green onions, finely chopped (plus extra to serve)

steps: Mix the beef with the green onion, carrot, garlic, soy sauce and sesame oil.
Dip a rice paper sheet in water until just pliable, lay it flat, spoon a log of filling along one edge and roll up tightly.
Snip each roll into 3–4 bite-size pieces with scissors.
Arrange on parchment in the air fryer, spray with oil and cook at 200°C (400°F) for 12–15 minutes until crisp and golden.
Whisk the sauce ingredients, thinning with warm water. Scatter the bites with sesame seeds and green onion and serve with the sauce.
recipes.notes: Estimated recipe: the creators share the full recipe and macros only by DM ("comment built") and in their sauce eBook, so the filling and sauce here are estimates based on the video. Swap in ground chicken or turkey if you like.

recipes.title: Bang Bang Cottage Cheese Sauce
steps: Pour into a squeeze bottle and refrigerate; it keeps 4–5 days. Great over beef-and-rice meal prep bowls.
recipes.notes: Recipe is the creators'; macros are estimated (their full macros are only sent by DM).

recipes.title: Chili-Lime Greek Yogurt Sauce
steps: Blend everything until smooth and pale green.
Pour into a squeeze bottle and refrigerate; it keeps 4–5 days. Great over rice bowls and salads.
recipes.notes: Recipe is the creators'; macros are estimated (their full macros are only sent by DM).
